'''2018 European MPC Results Jimmy Faelens LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jimmy Faelens]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jimmy Faelens]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
